Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a two-vehicle collision in Conroe, Texas, where a westbound sedan and an eastbound sport
utility vehicle came together head-on at low speed. Driver 1, the operator of the sedan, reported pain in the right
shoulder and was evaluated at the scene. Driver 2, operator of the SUV, stated that the sequence of events matched
what Driver 1 described, and two independent witnesses gave accounts consistent with both drivers. Scene
photographs were taken and show front-end damage to both vehicles that corresponds to the direction and force of
the impact described by the parties. Responding officers confirmed that Passenger was seated in the sedan at the
time of the collision and was not separately injured. Nothing observed at the scene suggested prior damage to either
vehicle, and no earlier collision involving the sedan was reported to officers. Driver 1 was confirmed as a named
insured on the policy covering the sedan. Officers issued no citations at the scene. This report is complete as of the
time of filing and will be supplemented if additional information becomes available.
</page>
